clues.text: When Joseph went up to Canaan to bury Jacob, only the children and flocks were left behind here.
During the plague of hail on Egypt, this was the only place spared, for the Israelites lived there.
Joseph sent word for his father Jacob to come down from Canaan and settle in this land, near him.
Pharaoh told Joseph to settle his father and brothers here, in the best part of Egypt.
In Egypt, the Israelites acquired property in this region and became fruitful, increasing greatly in number.
Joseph rode out in his chariot to this land to meet his father Israel, embraced him, and wept.
Joseph coached his brothers to tell Pharaoh they kept livestock, since Egyptians detested such men, so they could live in this land.
